# Script Summary
This function runs differential analysis (RPPA) on TCGA projects using provided covariates from the "{OMICS_LAYER}_covariates.rds" file. 
You can control which TCGA projects to run by subsetting the covariates file to only include specific projects. 

This script runs/knits `02_PanCancer-Regression-RPPA.Rmd`

# INPUTS
 - rmd = Path to RMD to knit (needs to be set up to accept input parameters) 
 - output_dir = Where the html knitted outputs will be saved
 - covariate_file = covariates file created from 
 /restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/TCGA-GDC/metadata/scripts/05_Covariates.Rmd
 
```{r} 
render_reports <- function(rmd, output_dir, covariate_file) {
  for (i in 1:nrow(covariate_file)) {
    try({
    #Specify input parameters from covariate file
    cancer_type <- covariate_file$cancer_type[i]
    include_gender <- covariate_file$include_gender[i]
    include_race <- covariate_file$include_race[i]
    include_hpv <- covariate_file$include_HPV_status [i]
    include_subtype <- covariate_file$include_subtype[i]
    races_to_include <- covariate_file$races_included[i]
    include_purity <- covariate_file$include_purity[i]
    
    # Define the specific output file name for each cancer type
    output_file_name <- paste0(output_dir, cancer_type, "_RPPA_Differential_Analysis.html")
    
    #Print updates
    print(paste0("Creating output for ", cancer_type, " at ",output_file_name, " ..."))
    
    # Render the R Markdown document with the specific parameters
    rmarkdown::render(input = rmd,
                      output_file = output_file_name,
                      params = list(cancer_type = cancer_type,
                                    include_gender = include_gender,
                                    include_race = include_race,
                                    include_hpv = include_hpv,
                                    include_subtype = include_subtype,
                                    races_to_include = races_to_include,
                                    include_purity = include_purity))
    
    print("Done!")
    })
  }
}

```

# Paths 
```{r}
#Define inputs to "render_reports" input
regression_rmd <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging_pbock/scripts/RPPA/02_PanCancer-Regression-RPPA.Rmd"
output <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging_pbock/results/RPPA/htmls/"
covariates <- readRDS("/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/CBMrepositoryData/TCGA-GDC/metadata/covariates/RPPA_covariates.rds")
```

# Example runs 
Subset to first row of covariate files to test (TCGA-ACC)
```{r}
#first row of covariates file which is TCGA-ACC
covariate_test <- covariates[1,1:dim(covariates)[2]]
```

Subset to a specific project of interest
```{r}
#Run specific project
specific_project <- covariates[covariates$cancer_type == "TCGA-HNSC",]
```

Provide the full "covariates" variable to run all TCGA projects
```{r}
#Call function
render_reports(rmd = regression_rmd, output_dir = output, covariate_file = covariates)
```
